arxiv-2101-06332.title: Compressed Sensing for STM imaging of defects and disorder
arxiv-2101-06332.creator: Brian E. Lerner, Anayeli Flores-Garibay, Benjamin J. Lawrie, Petro Maksymovych
arxiv-2101-06332.description: Abstract Compressed sensing (CS) is a valuable technique for reconstructing measurements in numerous domains. CS has not yet gained widespread adoption in scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), despite potentially offering the advantages of lower acquisition time and enhanced tolerance to noise.

arxiv-2101-11633.title: Statistical physics through the lens of real-space mutual information
arxiv-2101-11633.creator: Doruk Efe Gökmen, Zohar Ringel, Sebastian D. Huber, Maciej Koch-Janusz
arxiv-2101-11633.description: Abstract Identifying the relevant degrees of freedom in a complex physical system is a key stage in developing effective theories in and out of equilibrium. The celebrated renormalization group provides a framework for this, but its practical execution in unfamiliar systems is fraught with ad hoc choices, whereas machine learning approaches, though promising, lack formal interpretability.

arxiv-2306-10338.title: Trauma lurking in the shadows : A Reddit case study of mental health issues in online posts about Childhood Sexual Abuse
arxiv-2306-10338.creator: Orchid Chetia Phukan, Rajesh Sharma, Arun Balaji Buduru
arxiv-2306-10338.description: Abstract Childhood Sexual Abuse (CSA) is a menace to society and has long-lasting effects on the mental health of the survivors. From time to time CSA survivors are haunted by various mental health issues in their lifetime. Proper care and attention towards CSA survivors facing mental health issues can drastically improve the mental health conditions of CSA survivors.

arxiv-2312-10131.title: Hybrid Paul-optical trap with large optical access for levitated optomechanics
arxiv-2312-10131.creator: Eric Bonvin, Louisiane Devaud, Massimiliano Rossi, Andrei Militaru, Lorenzo Dania, Dmitry S. Bykov, Markus Teller, Tracy E. Northup, Lukas Novotny, Martin Frimmer
arxiv-2312-10131.description: Abstract We present a hybrid trapping platform that allows us to levitate a charged nanoparticle in high vacuum using either optical fields, radio-frequency fields, or a combination thereof. Our hybrid approach combines an optical dipole trap with a linear Paul trap while maintaining a large numerical aperture (0.77 NA).

arxiv-2403-13131.title: Bosonic near-CFT 1 models from Fock-space fluxes
arxiv-2403-13131.creator: Yiyang Jia
arxiv-2403-13131.description: Abstract We construct a family of near-CFT 1 models with a conserved U(1) charge, whose basic degrees of freedom are canonical bosons. The Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model—the first microscopic model that realizes the near-CFT 1 dynamics—is based on random p p -local interactions among fermions.

arxiv-2408-14186.title: Affine steerers for structured keypoint description
arxiv-2408-14186.creator: Georg Bökman 1, Johan Edstedt 2, Michael Felsberg 2, Fredrik Kahl 1
arxiv-2408-14186.description: Abstract We propose a way to train deep learning based keypoint descriptors that makes them approximately equivariant for locally affine transformations of the image plane. The main idea is to use the representation theory of GL(2) to generalize the recently introduced concept of steerers from rotations to affine transformations.

arxiv-2501-09416.title: Physical Layer Design for Ambient IoT
arxiv-2501-09416.creator: Rohit Singh 1 , Anil Kumar Yerrapragada 2 , Radha Krishna Ganti 3
arxiv-2501-09416.description: Abstract There is a growing demand for ultra low power and ultra low complexity devices for applications which require maintenance-free and battery-less operation. One way to serve such applications is through backscatter devices, which communicate using energy harvested from ambient sources such as radio waves transmitted by a reader.

arxiv-2504-09008.title: A Linear and Scalable Cutting-Plane Algorithm for Electricity Pricing
arxiv-2504-09008.creator: Matías Romero GSB, Columbia University New York, NY 10027, USA mer2262@columbia.edu, Felipe Verástegui IEOR, Columbia University New York, NY 10027, USA fav2114@columbia.edu, Matías Villagra IEOR, Columbia University New York, NY 10027, USA mjv2153@columbia.edu
arxiv-2504-09008.description: Abstract We propose a linear cutting-plane pricing algorithm tailored for large-scale electricity markets, addressing nonconvexities arising from the Alternating Current Optimal Power Flow equations. We benchmark our algorithm against a Direct Current (DC) approximation and the Jabr Second-Order Cone (SOC) relaxation under both the Integer Programming and Convex Hull pricing rules.

arxiv-2507-19037.title: MLLM-based Speech Recognition: When and How is Multimodality Beneficial?
arxiv-2507-19037.creator: Yiwen Guan, Viet Anh Trinh, Vivek Voleti, Jacob Whitehill
arxiv-2507-19037.description: Abstract Recent advances in multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have opened new possibilities for unified modeling of speech, text, images, and other modalities. Building on our prior work [ 1 ] , this paper examines the conditions and model architectures under which multiple input modalities can improve automatic speech recognition (ASR) accuracy in noisy environments.

arxiv-2511-04759.title: HiSAXy: A fast methodology for solar wind structure identification in millions of time series
arxiv-2511-04759.creator: Hala Lamdouar, Sairam Sundaresan, Anna Jungbluth, Sudeshna Boro Saikia, Amanda Joy Camarata, Nathan Miles, Marcella Scoczynski, Mavis Stone, Anthony Sarah, Andrés Muñoz-Jaramillo, Ayris Narock, Adam Szabo
arxiv-2511-04759.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hala Lamdouar, Sairam Sundaresan, Anna Jungbluth, Sudeshna Boro Saikia, Amanda Joy Camarata, Nathan Miles, Marcella Scoczynski, Mavis Stone, Anthony Sarah, Andrés Muñoz-Jaramillo, Ayris Narock, Adam Szabo. We present a hybridized unsupervised clustering algorithm HiSAXy as a novel way to identify frequently occurring magnetic structures embedded in the interplanetary magnetic field (IMF) carried by the solar wind.

arxiv-2602-19691.title: Smoothness Adaptivity in Constant-Depth Neural Networks: Optimal Rates via Smooth Activations
arxiv-2602-19691.creator: Yuhao Liu, Zilin Wang, Lei Wu, Shaobo Zhang
arxiv-2602-19691.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yuhao Liu, Zilin Wang, Lei Wu, Shaobo Zhang. Smooth activation functions are ubiquitous in modern deep learning, yet their theoretical advantages over non-smooth counterparts remain poorly understood. In this work, we study both approximation and statistical properties of neural networks with smooth activations for learning functions in the Sobolev space W s , ∞ ​ ( [ 0 , 1 ] d ) W^{s,\infty}([0,1]^{d}) with s > 0 s>0 .

pmc-11308499.title: Insights into the interplay between gut microbiota and lipid metabolism in the obesity management of canines and felines
pmc-11308499.creator: Kaiqi Li, Xiangyu Xiao, Yuling Li, Sichen Lu, Jianghang Zi, Xiaoqiang Sun, Jia Xu, Hao-Yu Liu, Xiaoqiong Li, Tongxing Song, Demin Cai
pmc-11308499.description: Obesity is a prevalent chronic disease that has significant negative impacts on humans and our companion animals, including dogs and cats. Obesity occurs with multiple comorbidities, such as diabetes, hypertension, heart disease and osteoarthritis in dogs and cats. A direct link between lipid metabolism dysregulation and obesity-associated diseases has been implicated.

pmc-12461337.title: Thermodynamics of Protonation and Prototropic Equilibria in Simple para- and Di-meta-Substituted Phenols
pmc-12461337.creator: Andrea Kováčová, Martin Michalík, Horst Hartmann, Vladimír Lukeš
pmc-12461337.description: The systematic ab initio G4 study of para- and di-meta-substituted phenol derivatives is presented for the gas phase and the model water environment. The thermodynamics of proton addition was considered based on calculated proton affinities for unprotonated and monoprotonated compounds.

pmc-12592286.title: Intelligent design and synthesis of nucleobase and amino acid-based ligands to inhibit the JAK2 enzyme to treat rheumatoid arthritis
pmc-12592286.creator: Ameneh Zarei, Alireza Fatahi
pmc-12592286.description: Rheumatoid arthritis is the most prevalent form of autoimmune arthritis. In modern drug development, computer-aided drug design plays a crucial role not only in discovering new therapeutic compounds but also in assessing their potential efficacy. This study employs ligand-based pharmacophore modeling to identify novel drug candidates without requiring an initial target protein structure.

uslaw-usc-t15-s634f.title: 15 U.S.C. § 634f — Reports
uslaw-usc-t15-s634f.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s634f.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 14A (Aid To Small Business). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Chief Counsel may from time to time prepare and publish such reports as he deems appropriate. Not later than one year after June 4, 1976, he shall transmit to the Congress, the President and the Administration, a full report containing his findings.
